info.name: SIMRS v1.0.0 — End-to-End Dummy Visit
info.description: Run once, sequentially, on disposable dummy DB only. Creates permanent dummy patient, masters, visit, payments. No runtime proof until executed. On error inspect before repeating any payment. Keys generated only in first attempt requests; manually preserve original key/payload on ambiguous response. Do not export tokens.
